claims.text: en: Appeal to emotion; định nghĩa: dùng cảm xúc thay cho lý do

sources.quote: There is nothing wrong with using emotions when you argue, but it's a mistake to use emotions as the key premises

claims.text: liệt kê cảm xúc sợ hãi, thương hại, tội lỗi, tự hào; thương hại thuộc nhóm này

sources.quote: appeals for sympathy or pity are mistakenly thought to be evidence
is accepted merely because the appeal arouses your feelings of anger, fear, grief

claims.text: not_fallacy_when: cảm xúc đi kèm lý do thực sự liên quan

sources.quote: There is nothing wrong with using emotions when you argue
